title: Say Again
want: Decide whether to close on a dimmed lamp's distress call that answers every challenge with the same stock reply.
at_stake: Closing on a false call costs your crew time and exposure, and leaving a true one costs the lamp.
complication: A challenge phrase on the open channel gets: Say again your request. Hold station. (complications.md, distress call 6)

approaches.label: Send the challenge phrase again, slowly
approaches.npc_reaction: holds the tender at one speed

approaches.label: Cut the emitter quietly before closing
Ask the captain to hold the tender back

Send the challenge phrase again, slowly.clean: the keepers tell other tenders your crew tested the call before it moved
Send the challenge phrase again, slowly.cost: the tender's captain charges your crew for the tender's lamp time spent waiting on the reply
Send the challenge phrase again, slowly.fail: the stock reply never changes and your crew pays the captain for the time lost

Cut the emitter quietly before closing.clean: the keepers pay your crew for clearing a false emitter without a shot fired
Cut the emitter quietly before closing.cost: the emitter's burst damages your crew's antenna and your crew pays for it
Cut the emitter quietly before closing.fail: the second emitter wakes and your crew pays the tender for the lamp it starved

Ask the captain to hold the tender back.clean: the captain pays your crew for the safe approach it asked for
Ask the captain to hold the tender back.cost: your crew pays the captain's fee for holding the tender off
Ask the captain to hold the tender back.fail: the lamp dims further while the tender waits and your crew pays for the delay
